basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Text lines; set how many with lines.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Text, circular, rectangular, rounded, button and image shapes.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Pulse (default), wave, or "false" for no animation.

composition.title: Avatar, title and paragraph
composition.description: Combine an avatar with a title and paragraph, or with plain lines.

card.title: Card
card.description: The card variant lays out an avatar, title and paragraph; active highlights it.

loading.title: Loading state
loading.description: Wrap the real content and render it once loading is false.

decorative.title: Decorative blocks
decorative.description: decorative renders one bare aria-hidden placeholder to compose your own layout inside a container that exposes the busy state.

skeleton-text.title: SkeletonText
skeleton-text.description: A block of text lines whose last line is shortened to read like real text.

SkeletonProps.width: Width of each line (numbers are pixels)
SkeletonProps.height: Height of each line (numbers are pixels)
SkeletonProps.children: Real content, rendered once loading is false
SkeletonProps.loading: Shows the placeholder; set to false to render children
SkeletonProps.borderRadius: Custom corner radius of each line
SkeletonProps.style: Inline styles applied to each line
SkeletonProps.active: Highlights the card variant as active
SkeletonProps.paragraph: Shows a paragraph placeholder (replaces the lines)
SkeletonProps.title: Shows a title placeholder (replaces the lines)
SkeletonProps.aria-label: Accessible name of the loading placeholder (rendered as a busy status region)
SkeletonProps.ref: Ref to the root <div> element; only attached while loading (children are rendered as-is otherwise)
SkeletonProps.decorative: Renders one bare decorative placeholder (aria-hidden span) instead of the announced loading region
SkeletonProps.size: Edge length of a decorative circular placeholder; wins over width and height

SkeletonTextProps.lineHeight: Height of each line (numbers are pixels)
SkeletonTextProps.gap: Space between lines: a spacing-scale step or any CSS length
SkeletonTextProps.shrinkLast: Shrinks the last line to 70% width

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Lines, or an avatar with a heading and a paragraph. The skeleton is a busy status region named "Loading" (or its aria-label).

variants.title: Variants and animations
variants.description: Placeholder shapes (width / height accept pixels), pulse / wave / no animation, and the card variant.

loading.title: Loading content
loading.description: Set loaded once the data is there: the skeleton then renders its slotted content. Click Reload to replay.

composition.title: Custom composition
composition.description: decorative skeletons and minerva-skeleton-text are hidden from assistive technologies: compose them in a container that announces the busy state.

props.loaded: Shows the slotted content instead of the placeholder.
props.heading: Shows a title placeholder (replaces the lines).

slots.default: Real content, rendered once loaded is set.

props.noShrinkLast: Keeps the last line at full width.
